quality_effect: Use OS Terrain 50 only as coarse independent corroboration and require metadata, geodesy and WCS-subset consistency before comparison.

official_sources.title: Accuracy of OS Net, OSTN15 and OSGM15

verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 ASCII grid is supplied as 10km tiles with 50m by 50m cells.
Terrain 50 height values are given to the nearest 0.1m.
Per-tile metadata records British National Grid EPSG:27700 and Ordnance Datum Newlyn EPSG:5701.
Per-tile metadata can contain earliest and latest flying dates for revision lineage.
OS Terrain 50 currently reports no live known data issues on its official known-issues page.
OS states OSTN15 can be treated as effectively error-free apart from GNSS positional errors in the transformation context described.
Agreement between OSTN15 and old triangulation network stations is about 0.1m rms for Great Britain.
OSGM15 standard height error for Great Britain is 0.008m, excluding GNSS heighting error.
Terrain 50 is too coarse to serve as parcel-edge ground-height truth and is limited to independent coarse corroboration.
WCS GetCoverage supports trimming operations that return only cells inside the requested subset bounds.
WCS GetCoverage supports slicing operations that reduce a dimension at a requested slice point.
Overlapping GetCoverage requests should return identical values at common locations, providing a service consistency check.
